item.description:
• Double-click empty space in the top bar to zoom the window (per system setting); drag it to move the window
  • Each file remembers its reading position and split ratio across switches and restarts
  • Files changed by other apps reload automatically; with unsaved edits you choose what to keep
  • Faster file opening: quicker Markdown rendering, editor setup and preview loading
  • "Keep All" option in the quit confirmation

• 双击顶栏空白处按系统设置缩放窗口，顶栏空白处可拖动窗口
  • 每个文件记住阅读位置与编辑预览分栏比例，切回或重启后恢复
  • 文件被其他程序修改时自动重新载入；有未保存修改时提示选择
  • 打开文件更快：Markdown 渲染、编辑区初始化与预览加载均已优化
  • 退出确认增加「全部暂留」
